In history, the Central Work Conference met from November 10 to December 15, 1978, and the Third Plenum of the Eleventh Central Committee met from December 18 to 22. It decided to shift the focus of the whole Party's work to socialist modernization. The 27 days after Mao Zedong's death

On September 16, a joint editorial of the two papers and one journal quoted the line “Act according to the principles laid down” and called it Mao Zedong's deathbed instruction. Hua Guofeng later said that what Mao Zedong wrote to him was “Act according to past principles,” and that “Act according to the principles laid down” was a falsification. At the Politburo meeting on September 29, Jiang Qing asked for a work assignment and wanted Mao Yuanxin to stay in Beijing to handle Mao Zedong's papers. Hua Guofeng and Ye Jianying argued that Mao Yuanxin should go back to Liaoning. They fought late into the night. On October 4, Guangming Daily ran Liang Xiao's article “Always Act According to the Principles Laid Down by Chairman Mao.” History See Wikipedia, “Smashing the Gang of Four” (search summary).

No reliable record was found of what Wang Hongwen said at the September 29 meeting.
